{{Quote|We need to find a ship. And I think the only one around here belongs to the Separatists. We know they have a landing ship. They might have a shuttle.''"<br />"''Sir, you're talking about stealing from the ''clankers''? Count me in.|Anakin Skywalker and Captain Rex|<ref name="Defenders of Peace" />}}
A '''''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle''' was brought to [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], who sought to test his new [[Defoliator/Legends|Defoliator]] [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]] on the [[Planet/Legends|world]]. The [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was later stolen by a small team led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]].<ref name="Defenders of Peace" />
